2b55f30e7ffea542.description: At Mirai, a Scopely Studio, we're passionate about creating engaging gaming experiences that delight millions of players worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, AI platform, who builds products and can see the platform inside them. You will write product features yourself, and you will turn what repeats across products into shared services and libraries the rest of the team builds on. The platform comes out of real product work, one product at a time, not ahead of it. Our AI Native Engineering team builds software for Scopely game teams and internal departments: tools that use large language models (LLMs) for bug triage, player feedback analysis, market and company research, and contract analytics, alongside direct-to-consumer web stores for Scopely games. Most of these tools repeat one pattern: connect a source system, build a trusted store, put an LLM or governed logic over it, and control who can see what. Today each product builds that pattern its own way, with its own model setup, its own access rules, and its own safety controls. This is a software engineering role, not an infrastructure role. Our DevOps and SRE engineers own clusters, pipelines, and cloud provisioning. If your recent work is mainly infrastructure with little product code, this is not the right fit. What you will do Build product features end to end on our internal AI tools, in TypeScript or Python, from design through production. Find what our products build separately and turn it into shared services and libraries: model access and spend, identity and permissions, retrieval, tool servers, and the controls around LLM calls. Move products onto them one at a time, without stopping delivery. Build MCP tool servers that expose company data to agents and chat tools, with the end user's permissions enforced before any data reaches the model. Help introduce relationship-based access control across products, so access rules are defined once and applied to both database queries and vector search. Standardize model access through our LLM gateway, so model choice, cost, and usage are set in one place rather than in each repository. Spread the safety patterns that live in one project each today to every product: prompt-injection handling, kill switches, sandboxed execution of generated code, and locked-down data access. Make the shared pieces easy to adopt: clear APIs, versioning, templates, and documentation another engineer can follow without asking you. Set the standard in code review, including for AI-assisted code, and mentor engineers through review, pairing, and design. Own incidents on what you build, and work with our DevOps engineers on how it is deployed and run. What we are looking for Six or more years building and running production software, including at least one shared service, library, or internal API that other engineers or teams depended on. Strong TypeScript and Node.js, and strong Python. Our services are split across both. Shipped LLM features to production: retrieval over embeddings, tool calling, structured output, and a way of checking output quality. Designed APIs or libraries other engineers build on, with real attention to versioning, compatibility, safe defaults, and documentation. Built multi-tenant or permission-sensitive systems, and knows where to enforce access so data never reaches a user, or a model, that should not see it. Treats model output and retrieved content as untrusted input. Solid system design: service boundaries, data modeling, failure handling, idempotency, and cost. Production experience on AWS, with infrastructure as code in Terraform or similar, enough to own how your services ship alongside DevOps. Writes tests as part of the work and treats CI checks as gates, not suggestions. Clear written and spoken English, and able to explain technical tradeoffs to product and business stakeholders. Uses AI coding tools and verifies their output. You understand, can prove, and own what you merge. The Stack Languages: TypeScript and Node.js, Python 3.11. Services: Express, FastAPI, Next.js AI: OpenAI models and embeddings, LangChain, access control with SpiceDB (designed, being introduced) Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK, an internal LLM gateway built on LiteLLM over Amazon Bedrock Cloud and Delivery: AWS (EC2, ECS Fargate, Lambda, Data: PostgreSQL (Amazon RDS and Aurora), BigQuery, Amazon OpenSearch Serverless for vector search App Runner, S3, CloudFront), Terraform, GitLab and GitHub Identity and Access: Okta, OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, relationship-based access control with SpiceDB (designed, being introduced) Work Tracking : Jira, Confluence Nice to Have Relationship-based access control in practice, with SpiceDB, OpenFGA, or similar An LLM gateway such as LiteLLM or Amazon Bedrock, and evaluation or tracing tools such as Braintrust, Langfuse, or LangSmith An agent orchestration framework such as LangGraph A shared platform that served several teams or departments rather than one product Experience in games, or Arabic Mobile Phone Allowance Health Insurance Performance Bonus Relocation support where applicable

2b110dd37886678c.description: The role leads architectural and MEP fire and life safety compliance for commercial high-rise, hospital, mixed-use, industrial, warehouse and residential developments, from concept design through approvals, construction, testing and handover. You will coordinate with architects, MEP engineers, main contractors, clients, specialist subcontractors and consultant review teams. SCE Professional Engineer license is mandatory. Architectural Fire and Life Safety Develop and review fire and life safety strategies throughout the project lifecycle. Verify fire-rated walls, floors, doors, shafts, façades, structural protection, compartmentation, fire/smoke barriers and protected openings. Assess egress, occupant loads, travel distances, dead ends, exit discharge capacity, refuge provisions, horizontal exits and emergency access. Review exit stairs, lobbies, fire-fighting shafts, smoke control zones, fire command centers, emergency signage and accessibility. Evaluate interior finishes, insulation, façade/cladding materials and penetration systems for required fire performance and approved certification. Apply occupancy-specific requirements: high-rise evacuation/smoke management; hospital defend-in-place/phased evacuation; mixed-use separation; industrial process hazards; warehouse storage heights/commodity risks; and residential sleeping-occupancy protection. MEP Fire Safety Integration Fire alarm and detection: Review addressable systems; smoke, heat, flame, aspirating, beam, duct, linear heat and gas detection; manual call points; audible/visual notification; voice evacuation; fire telephones/two-way emergency communication; zoning, monitoring, survivability and building-system interfaces. Cause-and-effect: Develop and verify matrices, operating sequences, input/output logic, alarm verification, supervisory/trouble signals, graphical annunciation and fire command centre controls. Coordinate elevators, access control, doors, dampers, smoke control, generators, gas shut-off, process equipment and BMS interfaces. Sprinklers and water-based suppression: Review hazard classification, design density/area, sprinkler types/temperature ratings, zoning, valves, hydraulic calculations, seismic restraints where applicable, concealed-space protection, obstructions and occupancy-specific arrangements. Standpipes, hydrants and hose reels: Coordinate wet/dry risers, landing valves, hose stations, yard hydrants, fire department connections/inlets, pressure-reducing devices, zoning, residual pressures, coverage, accessibility, signage and fire-fighting access. Special-hazard suppression: Review clean-agent, water-mist, foam, wet/dry-chemical, CO₂ and local-application systems for kitchens, data/electrical rooms, turbines, fuel areas, laboratories, archives and other risks. Address enclosure integrity, discharge alarms, abort functions, interlocks, personnel safety and agent storage. Fire-water storage and pumping: Verify demand/duration, tanks, fire/jockey pumps, duty/standby arrangements, suction/discharge piping, test headers, controllers, power supplies, pressure zoning, relief provisions, pump-room ventilation/drainage, monitoring, access and testing facilities. Smoke management: Review extraction, make-up air, atrium/mall smoke control, car-park ventilation, stair/lobby pressurization, elevator-shaft protection, smoke reservoirs, curtains, fans, ducts, dampers, pressure-relief paths, tenability criteria, controls and emergency modes. HVAC interfaces: Coordinate AHU shutdown/operating modes, smoke/combination/fire dampers, duct smoke detectors, fire-rated ductwork, transfer-air openings, control panels, access doors and damper testing to prevent smoke migration across compartments. Emergency electrical systems: Review emergency/life-safety generators, ATS, UPS, emergency lighting, illuminated exit signs, fire alarm supplies, fire-pump feeds, smoke-control power, circuit segregation, selective coordination, fire-rated/mineral-insulated cables, protected routes, battery autonomy and electrical-room protection. Emergency communications: Coordinate public-address/voice alarms, fire-fighter telephones, radio enhancement where required, refuge communication, emergency control-room displays, elevator recall, fire-service lifts, door release, security integration and mass notification. Passive-fire interfaces: Coordinate tested fire-stopping for cables, conduits, pipes, ducts, busways, joints and mixed-service penetrations; rated shafts/enclosures; penetration labels; inspection access; insulation/movement compatibility; and maintenance of compartment ratings. Hazardous-material classification: Review inventories, quantities, physical/chemical hazards, storage/use, control areas, maximum allowable quantities, incompatibilities, occupancy classifications, separation distances and Safety Data Sheets for flammable/combustible liquids, gases, oxidizers, corrosives, toxics, reactive materials, aerosols and other regulated substances. Hazardous-material detection/controls: Coordinate combustible/toxic gas detection, oxygen-deficiency monitoring, leak detection, alarm set points, local/remote annunciation, emergency shut-off, isolation valves, excess-flow controls, process interlocks, emergency ventilation, standby power and fire alarm/BMS links. Storage/handling safeguards: Review approved cabinets/rooms, cylinder restraints, incompatible-material segregation, spill containment, drainage isolation, ventilation, bonding/grounding, explosion protection, pressure relief, purge systems, hazardous-area electrical classifications, emergency eyewash/showers and safe transfer/dispensing. Fuel, LPG and process hazards: Review tank capacities, day tanks, piping, pumps, loading/unloading, leak/gas detection, emergency isolation, ventilation, containment, separation, fire protection, vehicle-impact protection, shutdown logic and coordination with process safety studies. Emergency planning: Support fire/spill scenarios, pre-incident plans, emergency procedures, evacuation/shelter-in-place, responder information, hazard signage/labelling, decontamination, incident-control interfaces and authority coordination. Testing/acceptance: Define inspections, flushing, pressure/functional/integrated tests, alarm/control verification, smoke-control tests, pump acceptance, room-integrity tests, gas-detector calibration and suppression discharge tests where permitted, including records, training and handover requirements. Design Review, Coordination and BIM Review drawings, specifications, calculations, schedules, fire strategies, shop drawings, material submissions and method statements at each stage. Lead interdisciplinary workshops and resolve conflicts between architecture, structure, MEP, fire protection and operational requirements. Use BIM coordination/clash detection to resolve life-safety issues involving clearances, access, routing, compartment boundaries and maintainability. Maintain design comments, responsibility matrices, action trackers and closure evidence. Code Compliance and Authority Approvals Maintain project-specific code matrices covering the Bahrain Fire & Life Safety Code 2025 (effective 1 January 2026), Bahrain Civil Defence requirements, Saudi Building Code SBC 801, Saudi Civil Defense requirements, municipality conditions, client requirements and adopted NFPA standards. Apply project-adopted NFPA 101, 13, 72, 92 and 130, where applicable. Prepare/review fire strategy reports, authority drawings, calculations, compliance narratives, deviation requests, technical responses and resubmissions. Support Bahrain and Saudi Civil Defense submissions, inspections, permits, certificates, fire safety certification and relevant municipality/authority interfaces. 2ba2326317af8af1.description: Function: Product · 1 opening · Riyadh About SHIFTER SHIFTER is a Saudi B2B delivery orchestration platform. The role You will own SHIFTER's platform end to end: the merchant API and integrations, the merchant dashboard, the prepaid wallet, the rate-card engine, operator dispatch and the SLA engine. You decide what we build and in what order, write the specs, lead the engineering team through delivery, and answer for the results in production. You report to the CEO. Write clear specs and acceptance criteria (user stories, API contracts, edge cases, failure states) that engineers can build from without guessing. Run delivery with the engineering team in two-week sprints: planning, refinement, acceptance and release, with a release you can name every sprint. Define and track product KPIs: time to integrate a merchant, order success rate, on-time delivery against SLA, wallet top-up rate and support tickets per 1,000 orders. You have shipped products to production yourself and can show, with numbers, the result of at least two releases you owned (adoption, conversion, retention, cost or time saved). Strong technical fluency: you read API documentation, design REST endpoints and webhooks with engineers, and write SQL to answer your own questions. Hands-on agile delivery with a backlog tool (Jira, Linear or similar); a Scrum Product Owner certification (PSPO or CSPO) is a plus, not a substitute for results. Experience with dispatch, order management, payments or wallet systems is a strong advantage. Fluent Arabic and English, written and spoken. Based in Riyadh, on site. What we offer Competitive base salary plus performance-linked incentives. A founding role with direct impact on the company's growth and a clear path to leadership. Medical insurance and benefits in line with Saudi Labour Law. A professional culture built on numbers, transparency and ownership. How to apply Apply with your CV and a short note covering three things: a link to or description of a live product you owned, your exact role in it, and one metric it moved with the before and after numbers. 2b404a8b669c90ef.description: نبذة عن مهندس إدارة المشاريع تبحث شركة المدينه الانشائية للمقاولات عن مهندس إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، بمنطقة عسير. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على تخطيط المشاريع وتنفيذها ومراقبتها لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن النطاق الزمني والميزانية المحددة. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى مهندس إدارة المشاريع مسؤولية وضع وتنفيذ خطط متكاملة للمشاريع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة. يشمل ذلك إعداد الجداول الزمنية، وإدارة التكاليف والموارد، وتسهيل التواصل الفعال بين جميع الأطراف المعنية بالمشروع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتنفيذ خطة متكاملة للمشروع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة من حيث البنود والأزمنة، مع فهم الجوانب الفنية لتنفيذ العمل. تقدير الأوقات والمواعيد النهائية للمشروع، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام البرامج والتطبيقات المتخصصة، وتحديد المهام المجدولة وفترات تنفيذها والموارد المتاحة. إدارة التكلفة والموارد المطلوبة لإنجاز المشروع، بما في ذلك تخطيط وإدارة الموارد البشرية والمادية والمعدات والتقنيين، وتقدير التكلفة المتوقعة بالتعاون مع مهندسي التكاليف والمهندسين التنفيذيين، ومتابعة الإنفاق. إعداد وتطبيق خطة علاقات مع جميع الأطراف ذات الصلة بالمشروع، وتوفير أساس لتوزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. إتقان استخدام برامج وتطبيقات إعداد الجداول الزمنية للمشاريع. القدرة على إدارة التكاليف والموارد بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لإدارة العلاقات مع الأطراف المعنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في أبها، عسير، ضمن فريق عمل شركة المدينه الانشائية للمقاولات. تتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بإنجاز المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2b524c71e719f070.description: About the Role Microsoft is seeking a Senior Corporate Counsel to join the Middle East Legal Affairs team within Corporate, External and Legal Affairs (CELA). This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and reports to the Head of Legal Affairs for the Middle East. The role involves advising senior business leaders, strategic customers, and public sector stakeholders on complex Cloud and AI matters, contributing to Microsoft’s legal strategy and growth in Saudi Arabia and potentially other Middle East countries. Role Context and Scope This position serves as the lead Legal Affairs lawyer for Saudi Arabia, supporting some of Microsoft’s key markets in the Middle East. The Senior Corporate Counsel will act as a strategic and legal advisor to subsidiary leadership, collaborating with commercial and public sector teams to achieve business priorities and accelerate responsible Cloud and AI transformation. The role requires close collaboration with Microsoft executives, sales and technical teams, legal peers, external partners, customers, regulators, and regional and global CELA teams. Key Responsibilities Serve as the lead Legal Affairs lawyer for Saudi Arabia and potentially other Middle East countries, advising senior business, sales, and subsidiary leaders, and participating in relevant country leadership teams. Provide proactive and actionable advice on corporate, commercial, regulatory, and compliance matters, including Saudi regional headquarters and MISA requirements, data protection, AI regulation, data-centre matters, and financial services regulation. Advise commercial and public sector teams on complex transactions, new business models, public procurement, government contracting, intellectual property, licensing, competition law, and strategic partnerships. Identify and anticipate legal, geopolitical, country, and reputational risks; oversee relevant disputes and regulatory engagements; and advise on partner relationships, antitrust risk, and exclusivity. Build trusted relationships with regulators, senior legal officers at public and private sector customers, external legal professionals, and industry associations. Coordinate with CELA specialist teams, the Regional Deal Team, finance, HR, compliance, and the national technology organization to ensure clear allocation and consistent execution of responsibilities. Manage outside counsel and other service providers to drive cost efficiency and deliver coordinated support to the business. Leverage AI to drive innovation across the Middle East Legal Affairs team and contribute to the broader transformation of CELA in EMEA. Required Qualifications and Experience Law degree and qualification to practice in a recognized jurisdiction. 5-10 years of experience advising on public sector transactions, government contracting, and public procurement matters. Outstanding analytical and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex issues and provide clear, business-oriented advice. Demonstrated ability to develop creative solutions that balance legal risk and business objectives. Ability to work efficiently, meet demanding deadlines, prioritize workflow, and adapt to changes in a fast-paced environment. Professional fluency in both Arabic and English. Demonstrated leadership capability to influence senior stakeholders, shape strategy, and collaborate effectively across functions and cultures. High tolerance for ambiguity and change, strong team spirit, sound judgment, and commitment to Microsoft’s standards of integrity and compliance. Preferred Qualifications Significant experience practicing in sophisticated legal environments, with demonstrable experience in technology, corporate and commercial law, and regulatory compliance. Saudi regulatory and commercial contracting experience is preferred, as is in-house experience at a multinational company or experience at a leading international law firm. Strong knowledge of technology, data protection, AI, cloud, and related regulatory issues. Experience with data centers, financial services regulation, public sector technology matters, or other Middle East markets is preferred. Work Environment This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires in-country presence. Periodic travel to other Middle East locations may be required.

ضمان دقة السجلات ومطابقتها مع الأنظمة المعتمدة. كما يشمل الكشف عن الفروقات وتحليل أسبابها، مما يسهم في تعزيز الرقابة وتقليل الفاقد وتحسين كفاءة إدارة المخزون. المهام التشغيلية الرئيسية مطابقة نتائج الجرد الفعلي مع أرصدة الأنظمة (ERP / نظام المخزون). التنسيق مع مديري المستودعات والفروع أثناء تنفيذ عمليات الجرد. إعداد تقارير تفصيلية بنتائج الجرد ورفعها للإدارة المختصة. التحقق من الالتزام بإجراءات التخزين والصرف المعتمدة. المساهمة في تحسين ضوابط الرقابة على المخزون وتقليل الهدر والفاقد. إعداد التقارير عن حالة المنتجات المخزنة وأماكن التخزين. تنفيذ عمليات الجرد الدوري والمفاجئ حسب الخطة المعتمدة من إدارة المخزون. عدّ الأصناف فعليًا بدقة عالية وتسجيل نتائج الجرد كما هي دون تعديل أو تفسير. توثيق عمليات الجرد بمحاضر رسمية حسب الإجراءات المعتمدة وبشكل كامل وصحيح وواضح. إعداد مستندات الاستلام والتسليم الخاصة بالجرد وتوقيعها من الأطراف المعنية. رفع نتائج الجرد ومرفقاتها (نماذج، محاضر، مستندات استلام وتسليم) أولًا بأول إلى إدارة المخزون. التنسيق الميداني مع أمناء المستودعات أو الفروع أثناء تنفيذ الجرد وفق الصلاحيات. إعادة العد عند الطلب أو في حال الاشتباه دون اتخاذ أي إجراء تصحيحي ذاتي. الاحتفاظ بنسخ من مستندات الجرد حسب السياسات المعتمدة. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الالتزام بسياسات والعمليات وإجراءات التشغيل للآخرين. بيئة العمل يعمل مسؤول الجرد ضمن فريق شركة الماجد للعود في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة لضمان كفاءة إدارة المخزون.
